query.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long

exclusions.rationale: Health probes are operational endpoints, not user-facing agent actions.
Password, OAuth, refresh, reset, and destructive account routes are browser/web-app auth surfaces.
Admin routes are control-plane surfaces and should not be exposed by generated agent clients by default.
Inbound webhooks are server-to-server callbacks, not CLI or MCP tools.
Local development helpers should not be exposed by generated agent clients.
